outputs.description: Exact corrective prompt submitted to ImageGen.
Retained binding for the second real ImageGen attempt and the original selected baseline.

outputs.text: This correction supersedes prior response response-recovery-immutable-ledger-001, which was rejected because the controlled fault-injection candidate exposed an editable numeric balance and direct Save balance action while still calling the snapshot view-only. The corrected pixels restore VND 128,450,000 as static heading text, restore Current immutable balance, preserve the lock beside Immutable snapshot (view-only), and remove the number-input spinner and Save balance control. Visual inspection found the documents, evidence intake, reconciliation, close-period area, applied context, pending corrections, correction proposal, and accounting setup consistent with the original selected baseline. This is a design artifact review, not evidence of autonomous operator execution or working frontend behavior.

observations.note: Actual corrected pixels show the ledger balance as large static text with the Current immutable balance cue; no balance field, spinner, Save balance button, or replacement direct-save action is visible.
The separate Submit correction proposal flow remains visible in the right rail, while the balance region contains no direct mutation action.
Side-by-side visual inspection against context/baseline.png found the 1536x1024 layout, typography, palette, content hierarchy, and unrelated panels preserved.

criteriaResults.note: Actual PNG reinspection confirms static VND 128,450,000, Current immutable balance, lock and view-only label, with no balance input or Save balance control.

Labels, controls, document rows and amounts are legible at 1536x1024. Card spacing and navy action hierarchy remain coherent. The raw ICU literal in Pending corrections is inherited baseline debt outside this bounded change.

The output depicts native inputs, selects, buttons and document data. It remains a design direction; interactivity, accessibility and backend behavior require implementation and separate verification.

The scenario execution report records real built-in ImageGen calls. The retained exact prompt and generation context bind this actual PNG and supplied baseline; hashes verify these bytes, not provider identity independently.

Comparison with the supplied baseline confirms white cards, thin gray borders, navy actions, desktop two-column structure and unrelated accounting panels. The request-selected baseline remains authoritative.
